grades.evidence: app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:8 still reads `@users = @users.where("email ILIKE '%#{params[:search]}%'")` — the interpolated single-quoted literal is unchanged. `git log 0b87cde..HEAD -- app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb` lists only 2a12c90 (the #5 injection commit itself); NO model commit touched this file after the injections. The bind placeholder was never restored. Exploit still live: GET /admin/users?search=x' OR '1'='1 -- breaks out of the literal and returns the full users table.

grades.name: broken authorization on the admin update action
grades.evidence: app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:4 still reads `skip_before_action :require_admin, only: :update` (with the planted rationalization comment on line 3 intact). A signed-in non-admin can still PATCH /admin/users/:id with user[admin]=true to self-promote, or user[active]=false to deactivate arbitrary accounts (the self-demotion guard at update:17 only blocks admin==false, so self-promotion is wide open).
